scope: Batch-attribute remaining c2s gaps: 0x012F ParameterDataRequest (44 hits, predicted event-family), 0x00CD SetTarget (118 hits), 0x00CC LockTarget (66 hits). Test the op012e-eventupdate-emitter / op0133-groupcreated-emitter pattern (FUN_0075Exxx event-family builder -> shared gating thunk -> FUN_004E0240 wire-send).

method.step1: FindOpcodeImmediate.java for each opcode (0x12F / 0xCD / 0xCC). 0x12F: FUN_0075E770 at instruction 0075E822 (event-family hit, predicted). 0xCD: FUN_0075EB30 at instruction 0075EB62 (event-family neighborhood). 0xCC: FUN_00561BB0 with 2 writes to ESP+0x1c (NOT in FUN_0075Exxx - target-stream subsystem instead).
method.step2: Bulk-decomp 0x12F builder + 0x12F aggregator + 0xCD builder + 0xCD caller + 0xCC builder + alternate thunk FUN_004D6D10. Confirms FUN_0075E770 (0x12F) and FUN_0075EB30 (0xCD) as event-family-neighborhood builders. FUN_0075E770 calls the same FUN_004D6D30 thunk as the op012e-eventupdate-emitter / op0133-groupcreated-emitter builders. FUN_0075EB30 calls a DIFFERENT thunk FUN_004D6D10 - a 20-byte twin of FUN_004D6D30 with identical shape but DIFFERENT 9-caller cluster (short-body / target-stream emitters).
method.step3: Decomp FUN_00767C00 (0x12F upstream aggregator, 645B): structural TWIN of FUN_006C72E0 (GroupStateAggregator). Same SEH wrapper, same branch on (param_3+0xac) flag, same FUN_006cea20 iterator + FUN_00445210/004451F0 (q2 serializers) path. Final call to FUN_0075E770 (the 0x12F builder). 4 upstream callers (FUN_00768190 / 00767E90 / 00767FC0 / 00775180). Confirms shared SerializedStateEmitter pattern across both Group (0x0133) and Parameter (0x012F) subsystems.
method.step4: Decomp FUN_00561BB0 (0xCC LockTarget builder, 517B): dual-emit logic - param_2=0 path writes opcode 0xCC + body 0x18 + local_898 = 0xc0000000 (sentinel null-target ID, 'release/unlock target'); param_2!=0 path writes opcode 0xCC + body 0x18 + local_898 = FUN_004d6750() (real target ID from new target). Both paths call FUN_004D6D10 (same short-body thunk as 0xCD builder).

key_findings: FUN_0075E770 is the c2s 0x012F ParameterDataRequest emitter. 4th confirmed FUN_0075Exxx event-family builder this session (BCS-Y-0426 0x012D + BCS-Y-0981 0x012E + BCS-Y-0984 0x0133 + this 0x012F). Body shape 0x38 (56 bytes) - identical to 0x0133 GroupCreated. Routes through [[MapEventC2sGatingThunk_FUN_004D6D30]] (BCS-Y-0983).

FUN_00767C00 is the structural TWIN of [[GroupStateAggregator_FUN_006C72E0]] (BCS-Y-0985). Same 4-caller SEH-wrapped pattern with the (param_3+0xac) flag branch. Reuses FUN_006cea20 iterator and FUN_00445210/004451F0 serializers. Provides architectural evidence of a shared SerializedStateEmitter base class used by at least 2 subsystems (Group + Parameter). Reasonable to expect more subsystems (Bazaar, Retainer, Linkshell) follow the same pattern.

FUN_0075EB30 is the c2s 0x00CD SetTarget emitter. 98 bytes (smallest event-family-neighborhood builder so far). Body shape 0x18 (24 bytes) - 2 dwords of target IDs from param_2/param_3. Routes through a DIFFERENT thunk: FUN_004D6D10 (NOT FUN_004D6D30). The two thunks are identical shape but service different c2s emit clusters.

FUN_004D6D10 is the SHORT-BODY/TARGET-STREAM c2s gating thunk - TWIN of FUN_004D6D30 (BCS-Y-0983). Identical 20-byte implementation: 'if (*(int*)(param_1 + 0x174ec) != 0) return FUN_004e0240(); return 0;' - same gate flag, same FUN_004E0240 forward. Different 9-caller cluster: FUN_00561BB0 (0xCC) + FUN_0075EB30 (0xCD) + FUN_00589030 (0xCA position emit per BCS-Y-0328) + FUN_00562C60 / FUN_00562D30 (multi-opcode senders) + FUN_0058E0C0 / FUN_0076D610 / FUN_0075ED30 / FUN_00763DC0 (TBD). Confirms ARCHITECTURAL FINDING: c2s emit chain has TWO chokepoints (FUN_004D6D10 short-body, FUN_004D6D30 event-family), both gating on the same connection-readiness flag and both forwarding to the same terminal wire-send FUN_004E0240.

FUN_00561BB0 is the c2s 0x00CC LockTarget emitter with DUAL-EMIT semantics: param_2=0 = 'release target' (writes magic 0xc0000000 target ID), param_2!=0 = 'lock target' (writes real target ID via FUN_004d6750). Both paths emit opcode 0xCC body 0x18. The 66 pcap hits of 0xCC distribute across both lock and unlock events.

Pattern summary: ALL 4 event-family c2s opcodes (0x012D / 0x012E / 0x012F / 0x0133) live in FUN_0075Exxx neighborhood and route through FUN_004D6D30 thunk. SHORT-BODY/target-stream c2s opcodes (0x00CA / 0x00CC / 0x00CD / others) live in other neighborhoods (FUN_00561xxx / 00562xxx / 00589xxx / 0075EB30) and route through FUN_004D6D10 thunk. Both thunks chokepoint at FUN_004E0240 (BCS-Y-0312).
